items.docs: This GET endpoint retrieves a specific change object associated with an issue in a Bitbucket repository, allowing users to examine the detailed history of modifications made to a particular issue. By providing the workspace identifier, repository slug, issue ID, and change ID in the URL path, the API returns comprehensive information about a single change event, including what was modified, when the change occurred, and who made the modification.
